notes.title: Max&Maya conquers Kickstarter!
notes.content: So, you've got paws, the world has gone nuts, bananas and chimichanga, zombies are around every corner, dogs are fighting tooth and nail to get you. What are you gonna make of it? We have an advice for you :) Gather a feline army and [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/omgstudio/maxmaya]support us on Kickstarter![/url][/b]
